title: Casino UI Parts
description: 遊戲介面零件的 CSS 實驗，整理成分格展示：金色立體字、描邊字、PLAY 按鈕、轉盤、餘額列、牌背、下注標籤、緞帶標題、百家樂結果框與斜角邊框。每個零件一個 CSS 檔。
descriptionEn: CSS experiments for game UI parts in a grid: gold 3D text, outlined text, a PLAY button, a wheel, a balance bar, card backs, bet labels, ribbon titles, baccarat result boxes and beveled borders. One CSS file per part.
author: Antonio
